about: Where each licence text in this folder came from. Every text is copied verbatim from a file on the developer's machine, with its line endings made LF (git stores text so); SHA256SUMS pins that LF form. scripts/gen-third-party-notices.js refuses a text whose bytes differ from its pin, a text with no pin, and a text with no entry here.

texts.title: 7-Zip licence (License.txt)
texts.copiedFromWhat: downloaded from https://www.7-zip.org/license.txt by the licence compliance review on 2026-11-10
texts.note: This is TODAY's 7-Zip licence (it reads "7-Zip Copyright (C) 1999-2025 Igor Pavlov"). The notices design asks for the License.txt of the 7-Zip 19.00 source package, which nsis7z.dll 19.00 is built on; that file is not on this machine. Replace this one with it when the 7-Zip 19.00 source archive is fetched for the release page.
